name: item-light-controls
description: Verifies per-item light colour + brightness (PARITY-FURNLIGHT). Places a table lamp (a registered emitter), forces lights on at night, sets a custom lightColor + high lightIntensity, asserts the props persist, and screenshots the lit night scene (the lamp's pool should render brightly).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-props

waitFor.store: (() => { const it = state.items.find(i=>i.id==='lit-lamp'); return it && it.props.lightIntensity === 12 && it.props.lightColor === '#66ccff'; })()

steps.failMessage: light intensity/colour props did not persist
